issue.title: Recognize bare bead ids from any bead-store project key, not just the local sase- prefix
issue.description:
Proposed by epic land agent sase-uk.land after landing epic sase-uk (A link-traversing
SASE pager), discharging PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note 2, item (2), on phase bead sase-uk.1.
Not a defect and not caused by that epic: the narrow recognizer was a deliberate
false-positive guard the phase recorded as deferred.

`_BARE_BEAD_ID_RE` in `src/sase/pager/link_scan.py` recognizes a bare bead id in a
`PagerOrigin.BEAD` document only when it carries this checkout's own `sase-` project-key
prefix. That is what keeps a research document that happens to say `sase-core` from
sprouting a false bead link — the rule the epic plan's D3 states as "declared per
`PagerOrigin`, never globally". The cost is that a bead document from any other bead
store's project key paints no bare-id links at all, so the highest-value links on a
`sase bead show` screen (its child ids) go unkeyed for every non-`sase` project.

Scope: source the recognizable project keys from the bead store / enabled-project
inventory rather than hardcoding one prefix, keeping the precedence order in
`scan_links` (typed refs > URLs > file paths > origin-scoped bare tokens) and keeping
the false-positive guard: a hyphenated token must still look like a bead id from a real
project key, not any hyphenated word. `sase project list` and
`src/sase/task_types.py`-adjacent project resolution are the likely sources.

Reproduce: open `sase pager bead:<id>` (or `sase bead show <id>`) for a bead whose
project key is not `sase` and observe that its bare child ids carry no key capsules,
while the same document in this repo keys all of them. Verify with
`tests/pager/test_link_scan.py` plus `just check`.

task_type_fields.proposal: Source the pager link scanner's bare-bead-id recognizer from the live project-key inventory so BEAD-origin documents from any bead store key their child ids, instead of hardcoding this checkout's sase- prefix.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-uk's primitives phase deliberately scoped the recognizer to one project key as a false-positive guard and recorded generalizing it as deferred; nothing in the epic's goal depends on it.
